input: Research van conversion kits for a campervan build

gold.taskTitle: Research Van Conversion Kits for a Campervan Build
gold.taskDescription: Research available van conversion kits to find the best fit for a personal campervan build project.

questions.title: What type or size of van do you already own?
questions.description: Identify the van make, model, and size to narrow down compatible conversion kits.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the conversion kit?
questions.description: Establish a clear budget range to filter options by affordability.

questions.title: Will this be a full-time home or weekend adventure van?
questions.description: Understand the primary use case to determine the level of build complexity needed.

questions.title: How many people will regularly sleep in the van?
questions.description: Determine sleeping capacity requirements to identify kits with the right bed configuration.

questions.title: Do you want a complete kit or modular add-on components?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants an all-in-one solution or prefers to piece together individual modules.

questions.title: What is your target timeline to complete the build?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or timeframe to factor in kit availability and shipping lead times.

questions.title: How comfortable are you with DIY installation work?
questions.description: Gauge the user's skill level to prioritize kits that match their ability to self-install or need for professional fitting.
